pageData.heading: LAP  Top-up on an Existing Running Loan
pageData.para: A LAP Top-up is an additional loan amount sanctioned over your existing Loan Against Property without transferring it to another lender. You continue with the same bank, but with extra funds based on your eligibility.

cardData.title: Quick Access to Funds
cardData.para: Faster approval since the bank already has your records.

cardData.title: No New Loan Processing Hassle
cardData.para: Avoid the paperwork of taking a separate loan.

cardData.title: Lower Interest Rate than Personal Loans
cardData.para: A top-up on LAP is cheaper than unsecured loans.

cardData.title: Use for Any Purpose
cardData.para: Business needs, debt consolidation, home improvement, etc.

benefits.heading: Key Benefits
paraGraph: Higher Loan Amount – Based on property valuation & repayment history.
Lower Processing Time – Faster than taking a fresh LAP.
Affordable EMIs – Spread repayment over a long tenure.
Flexible Repayment – Prepayment & foreclosure options available.

cardData.title: Eligibility Criteria
cardData.para:
• Existing LAP with a good repayment track record
  • Adequate property value to justify additional funding
  • Stable income & financial stability
  • Sufficient repayment capacity based on income assessment

cardData.title: Documents Required
cardData.para:
• Loan Statement: Existing loan statement & outstanding balance proof.
  • KYC documents : PAN, Aadhaar, passport, voter ID.
  • Latest income proof : salary slips, ITR, bank statements.
  • Property valuation report : if required by the bank

list.text: Submit income documents & loan track record.

things.heading: When Should You Consider a top-up
paraGraph: When you need extra funds but don’t want to go through a new loan application.
When your property value has increased & you qualify for more funds.
When you have a good repayment track record & want quick access to additional capital.

thinkYouShouldKnow.heading: Things you should know
paraGraph: Independent Facilitator: Digital DSA operates as an independent loan facilitator and web aggregator, bridging the gap between loan consumers and licensed banks or NBFCs. We are not an authorized financial institution and do not offer loans directly.

Loan Approval: The sole discretion of approving or rejecting a loan lies with the respective bank or NBFC where the user applies. Digital DSA does not guarantee loan approval or offer assurance from any specific bank or NBFC. All loans are subject to credit approval, and their terms, conditions, fees, and charges apply.

Liability: Digital DSA is not responsible for any loss, damage, or failure at the user’s end during loan processing. The final decision of the bank or NBFC is binding on both the user and Digital DSA.

Important Information: This information is provided without considering your personal objectives, financial situation, or needs. Please assess its suitability before acting. Exclusive offers are available only when you avail of a loan through Digital DSA and meet specific conditions.
